entries.description: Judged Phase 17's 'risky' label on the Negative row to be about a per-shape route rather than about the cells, and tested that by trying the class-level argument. No error existed in Phase 17; the label was accurate when written. Four sessions of new rules made a route available that did not exist then.

findings.description: The Negative row is not 'risky' — it is the AboveOne argument mirrored. A bounded dividend closes a cell against a constant divisor in whichever direction the bound points. Reachable matrix ceiling is 23/25, not 25/25.
